name: founder-product-compiler
description: Compile founder product briefs into validated Product IR, readiness reports, executable specifications, and Charter-linked Goal DAGs.

interface.shortDescription: Turn product intent into a readiness-gated build contract.
interface.longDescription: Compile confirmed product briefs locally into deterministic Product IR, readiness findings, executable specifications, and Charter-linked vertical-slice goals. English-first and skills-only. Runtime requires no product account, API key, network, or auth; Codex host marketplace installation may still request host authorization because the marketplace metadata declares ON_INSTALL.
defaultPrompt: Compile this founder brief and report blockers.
Turn this product brief into a validated build contract.
Check whether this product intent is ready to execute.
